description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 marscan: the MAR/SAR recognition signatures: the 16 bp site awwrtaannwwgnnnc (one mismatch allowed) or its reverse gnnncwwnnttaywwt and the 8 bp site aataayaa or ttrttatt within 200 bp of each other; of a cluster of signatures the pair with the least distance is reported as the report out.txt (default format gff: the feature misc_signal with the positions of the two sites; every report format of EMBOSS, the report qualifiers of reportQualifiers). Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the report and graph options, the messages of the library; standard output, error stream, exit status and written files byte for byte). B09 WP63, F282.

sequence.description: The text of the sequence file (any input format of seqret), or a sequence as letters.

reportFormat.description: The report format (-rformat, default gff): simple, embl, genbank, gff, gff3, pir, swiss, dasgff, debug, listfile, dbmotif, diffseq, draw, restrict, excel, feattable, motif, nametable, regions, seqtable, srs, summary, table, tagseq.

reportQualifiers.description: Report qualifiers as typed on the command line: -raccshow -rdesshow -rusashow -norscoreshow -norstrandshow -rmaxall N -rmaxseq N (-rformat is the parameter reportFormat).

sequenceFormat.description: The input format (-sformat1); default: the program finds the format.

qualifiers.description: Sequence input qualifiers as typed after the sequence on the command line: -sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1, -slower1 -supper1 -snucleotide1 -sprotein1 -scircular1, -sid1 name, -sdbname1 db, -squick1, -iquery1 query, -ioffset1 bytes.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that the program may read (a file named by a USA, @file).

text.description: The text of the main output of the program (the report, or its standard output).

files.description: The other files the program wrote (sequences, features, graph data), by name.

messages.description: What the library printed on the error stream (warnings and errors).

errors.message: The program died: the messages of the library (a value it refuses, an input no reader reads, a sequence of the wrong kind)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused

examples.name: A run on a small input
